sections.kicker: Prepared for Moonkraft by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Moonkraft shows great work. Its headline could sit on any branding studio's site.
sections.keep: The big capital headline and the lowercase moonkraft wordmark. The type is sure of itself.

pins.quote: Designing systems that help brands think, grow, and stay relevant.
pins.what: The headline describes what every branding studio says.
pins.why: A studio's own front door is the one place its position has to show. Thinking, growing and staying relevant fits a hundred studios.
pins.how: Say who you do your best work for and what you will not do, in one line.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Founders compare you with every other studio on price, because the line gives them no other reason.

pins.quote: We partner with founders and brand teams worldwide
pins.what: The next sentence widens the headline again: founders, brand teams, worldwide.
pins.why: Everyone, everywhere is nobody in particular. The picture below it is far more specific than the words.
pins.how: Pick the kind of founder you have done your best work for and name them.
pins.label: Your intro
pins.cost: The right client cannot tell the page is meant for them.

pins.area: The first image is a mockup of a musician's website with the name nuevayu in large lowercase letters
pins.what: The first image is a real piece of work: a musician's own site, his name in big lowercase letters beside his portrait.
pins.why: Your work says more about who you are than your words do. It is also the one thing here that no other studio has.
pins.how: Let the work open the page and let it state your position.
pins.label: Your work
pins.cost: The proof sits under the fold while the weakest line sits on top.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Moonkraft's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Aesop, from another category. It never explains what it believes. The shops and the texts show it.
